explanation: Does f(r) → ∞? Here f(r) = liminf_n of the minimal normalized size |V||H(r)|/2ⁿ over linear covering codes V (with V + H(r) = F₂ⁿ). Taking the liminf correctly captures "the smallest constant such that there exists an infinite sequence of ns with |V_n| = (f(r) + o(1))2ⁿ/|H(r)|". Using ENNReal with 𝓝 ⊤ is the right way to say "→ ∞" (as the file explains for the all-n variant). The statement is faithful.
